items.headline: Illinois governor signs law setting new age and licensing rules for e-bike riders
items.summary: Gov. J.B. Pritzker has signed a bill into law that classifies electric bicycles into categories based on speed and imposes age and licensing rules on riders.

items.headline: 'I really fear for my life': Neighbors worry after dogs maul man to death in Illinois
items.summary: Police in Illinois are investigating after loose dogs mauled a man to death Thursday night. Neighbors say they worry since the dogs are still on the loose.
